enable_nat.description: Create a NAT gateway for the private subnets.

flow_log_destination.description: Where flow logs are shipped. Any shape the provider accepts.

name.description: Name prefix for every resource in the module.

single_nat_gateway.description: Share one NAT gateway across every private subnet.

subnets.type: map(object({ cidr = string, public = optional(bool), az = optional(string) }))
subnets.description: Subnets to create, keyed by name.

flow_log_role_arn.description: ARN of the role used to publish flow logs.

nat_gateway_ids.description: NAT gateway IDs, empty when enable_nat is false.

subnet_ids.description: Subnet IDs keyed by subnet name.
